reviews.title: Great app for privacy, does exactly what it promises
reviews.text:
Great app for privacy, does exactly what it promises.
I’ve been using Second Texting Number and it works great. If you need a second number to protect your real one, whether for online marketplaces, dating apps, work contacts, or anything else, this is the app to get. Setup is quick, texts go through reliably, and your personal number stays completely private. I’d recommend it to anyone who doesn’t want to hand out their real digits. Burner!
